saying: Most commenters ask FDA to require under- and over-escalation to be reported and gated as separate error classes, not blended into one accuracy or utility score, with sponsors prespecifying context- and capacity-justified asymmetric acceptance criteria (for example minimum sensitivity plus maximum over-escalation rate) that FDA reviews.

disagreement.text: Commenters split on which error direction should carry more weight: some say under-escalation is the more severe error and high sensitivity should be permitted or favored, while another argues over-escalation is more dangerous because it causes errors of commission such as unnecessary treatment and testing.

sides.summary: Under-escalation should be treated as the more severe error, allowing sponsors to prioritize sensitivity.
Over-escalation deserves equal or greater weight, given commission harms and diffuse, under-detected system harms.
